units.source_text: “师傅嘛，也许曾考虑过让少爷和我结婚。

en.t: The mistress may once have thought of having the young master and me marry.

units.source_text: 可也是心里想想而已，嘴里从来也没有提过。

en.t: But it was only something she thought to herself; she never once mentioned it aloud.

units.source_text: 师傅这种心思，少爷和我都有点意识到了。

en.t: The young master and I both had some sense that this was what the mistress had in mind.

units.source_text: 然而，我们两人并没有别的什么。

en.t: Even so, there was nothing else between the two of us.
We had always lived our separate lives.

units.source_text: 我被卖到东京的时候，只有他一个人给我送行。”

en.t: When I was sold off to Tokyo, he was the only one who came to see me off.

units.source_text: 他记得驹子曾这样说过。

en.t: He remembered Komako once saying this.
